sources.extracted_facts: Spykar is an India-focused denim-led youth brand. Blog copy uses practical Indian English, natural keywords, restrained claims, a soft CTA and the approved standing production structure.
Requested topic and phrases: denim on denim outfits, double denim styling, denim jacket outfits, and jeans and denim shirt.
Confident menswear-editorial tone; approximately 1,300–1,600 words including product modules; wash balance, non-blue washes, texture, fit, classic accessories and alternative denim pieces.
Trend-led and conversational tone; approximately 1,000–1,300 editorial words; short rules followed by seven street-style formulas, with explicit attention to washes, waist definition and proportions.
Direct retail-guide tone; approximately 1,600–1,900 words; ten outfit formulas, simple wash and proportion rules, accessories and a product CTA for men and women.
The live Spykar occasion guide contains only a short double-denim subsection. Other repository drafts mention the look briefly; no standalone published wash-fit-proportion guide was found.

sources.extracted_facts: Women's light-blue washed jacket: regular fit, long sleeves, spread collar and colourful upper-front embroidery. Women's dark-blue wide-leg jeans: cotton with stretch, high rise, five pockets and clean finish. Men's light-blue denim shirt: 100% cotton, regular fit, full sleeves, snap-button cuffs, two flap patch pockets and washed effect. Men's dark-blue Trooper jeans: cotton, regular fit, high rise, solid pattern and no fade. All four pages returned HTTP 200.

detector_notes.note: The final article title and publishable body, excluding repository frontmatter, FAQ JSON-LD and image handoff metadata, were checked on the live ZeroGPT website. The result displayed 'Your Text is Human written' and 10.6% AI GPT. Earlier passes scored 37% and 22.4%; flagged passages were revised with source-backed product detail and concrete fitting-room checks. The detector is treated as a weak editorial risk signal, not proof of authorship.
